about: Hand-checked rare fields for scripts/ark-intelligence-profiles.mts (2026-11-11). Every keyword candidate for tool use, sentinels, caching, mixed-species company, cleaners/hosts and playing dead was read by Claude Code; keep=true entries carry the stored field and the verbatim phrase that shows it, keep=false the reason it was not used. A candidate not listed is not used.
